column1: # ZAP baseline rules (make zap-baseline): <rule id>, a tab, IGNORE/WARN/FAIL, a tab, why. A rule not listed
# fails the scan when it finds something. Accept a finding here only with its reason (ADR 0065).

column3: Public files meant to be cached: the manifest, robots.txt and the sitemap.
A redirect with an empty body has no type to declare.
React escapes every attribute value, and the API validates every parameter that is echoed back.
The body of a sign-in redirect is the public page shell, with nothing personal in it.
Pages render per request with a fresh CSP nonce, so they are not stored, on purpose (ADR 0014).
style-src allows inline styles, which React and Radix set as attributes that cannot carry a nonce; scripts stay strict (lib/security/csp.ts).
Information only: the site is a modern web application.
Cross-origin isolation (COEP) would block the map tiles and Razorpay checkout, and the site uses nothing that needs it.
The CSRF token travels in a header taken from its cookie (core/csrf.py), not a hidden field; a form posted without the page's script carries none and is refused.
